source.title: GATE 2027 Computer Science and Information Technology syllabus
source.note: The GATE 2027 syllabi were revised; this enumeration follows the GATE 2027 CS document, not the earlier GATE 2026 wording.

line: Propositional and first order logic. Sets, relations, functions, partial orders and lattices. Monoids, Groups. Graphs: connectivity, matching, colouring. Combinatorics: counting, recurrence relations, generating functions.

subjects.name: Discrete Mathematics
subjects.line: Propositional and first order logic. Sets, relations, functions, partial orders and lattices. Monoids, Groups. Graphs: connectivity, matching, colouring. Combinatorics: counting, recurrence relations, generating functions.

topics.name: Combinatorics: Counting, Recurrence Relations, Generating Functions

subjects.name: Linear Algebra
subjects.line: Matrices, determinants, system of linear equations, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, LU decomposition.

subjects.name: Calculus
subjects.line: Limits, continuity and differentiability. Maxima and minima. Mean value theorem. Integration.

subjects.name: Probability and Statistics
subjects.line: Random variables. Uniform, normal, exponential, Poisson and binomial distributions. Mean, median, mode and standard deviation. Conditional probability and Bayes theorem.

topics.name: Mean, Median, Mode and Standard Deviation

subjects.name: Digital Logic
subjects.line: Boolean algebra and minimization - algebraic technique, Karnaugh map, tabular method. Design of combinational and sequential circuits. Number representation and arithmetic (fixed and floating point).

topics.name: Computer Arithmetic: Fixed and Floating Point

subjects.name: Computer Organization and Architecture
subjects.line: Instruction set and addressing modes. Design of arithmetic and logic unit (ALU). Design of control unit - hardwired and microprogrammed. Memory interfacing and hierarchy: performance, cache memory mapping. I/O interface (interrupt and DMA). Instruction pipelining, pipeline hazards.

topics.name: Design of the Arithmetic and Logic Unit
Memory Interfacing, Hierarchy and Cache Mapping

subjects.name: Programming and Data Structures
subjects.line: Programming in C. Recursion. Arrays, stacks, queues, linked lists, trees, binary search trees, binary heaps, graphs.

subjects.name: Algorithms
subjects.line: Searching, sorting, hashing. Asymptotic worst case time and space complexity. Algorithm design techniques: greedy, dynamic programming and divide-and-conquer. Graph traversals, minimum spanning trees, shortest paths.

topics.name: Asymptotic Worst Case Time and Space Complexity

subjects.name: Theory of Computation
subjects.line: Regular expressions and finite automata. Context-free grammars and push-down automata. Regular and context-free languages, pumping lemma. Turing machines and undecidability.

subjects.name: Compiler Design
subjects.line: Lexical analysis, parsing, syntax-directed translation. Runtime environments. Intermediate code generation. Local optimisation, Data flow analyses: constant propagation, liveness analysis, common subexpression elimination.

subjects.name: Operating System
subjects.line: System calls, processes, threads, inter-process communication, concurrency and synchronization. Deadlock. CPU and I/O scheduling. Memory management and virtual memory. File systems.

subjects.name: Databases
subjects.line: ER-model. Relational model: relational algebra, tuple calculus, SQL. Integrity constraints, normal forms. File organization, indexing (e.g., B and B+ trees). Transactions and concurrency control.

topics.name: Relational Model: Algebra and Tuple Calculus

subjects.name: Computer Networks
subjects.line: Principles of Layering; Basics of switching (circuit, packet and virtual circuit) and performance metrics; Data link layer: error detection, Medium Access Control, Ethernet; Distance vector and link state routing; IPv4 - Fragmentation, CIDR Notation, Network Address Translation; TCP - flow control and congestion control, socket API; DNS and HTTP.

topics.name: Data Link Layer: Error Detection and MAC
Distance Vector and Link State Routing
TCP: Flow Control and Congestion Control
Application Layer Protocols: DNS and HTTP

covered_by_playlist: Propositional Logic (connectives, equivalence, normal forms, inference, resolution, functional completeness)
First Order Logic (predicates and quantifiers, English translation, quantifier order and negation, validity, uniqueness, model size)

Sets, Relations, Functions (set basics and power sets, set identities, Cartesian product, relation properties and counting, equivalence relations and partitions, function counting, composition and inverse, countability)
not_covered_by_playlist: relation closures (reflexive, symmetric, transitive closure, Warshall) - taught here from the standard reference only
partial orders and lattices - the next topic in the cycle, deliberately not covered by this run
monoids and groups, graphs - not yet processed
every subject outside Discrete Mathematics - enumerated here, not yet processed
note: Every subject and topic of the GATE 2027 CS syllabus is enumerated in official order, cited to the GATE 2027 syllabus document of IIT Madras. A topic carries material='cards' when cards exist under content/subjects/<subject>/<topic>/ and 'planned' when the topic is enumerated but no card has been written yet; the site only ever renders topics that have cards. First order logic is enumerated immediately after propositional logic because the GATE 2027 line reads 'Propositional and first order logic'.
